original.what: The office itself: walls, window wall, door, carpet, the desk pedestal, office chairs, divider, printer cabinet

The interactive objects: the two monitors, keyboard and mouse, mobile phone and its stand, desk phone, sticky note, printer, shredder, USB stick, badge and lanyard, door intercom, desk drawer, whiteboard, mug and headphones

Printed and drawn art: the whiteboard, the sticky note, the Veltrix sign and badge, the printed bank change form, the USB label, the security poster, the intercom camera still and the vendor master file
The baked lighting in every texture
original.how: Rendered with Blender Cycles by tools/blender/bake.py
Drawn as inline SVG in engine/ui/icons.js

original.what: All sounds: room tone, keyboard, printer, shredder, phone, desk phone, intercom
original.how: Synthesised in the browser with the Web Audio API (engine/core/audio.js). There are no audio files.
The player’s own browser speech, using only voices that run on the device, and only when sound is on. Every line is captioned. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
